source_context: Large-scale extension of the accepted LeanFrontier Horadam, Fibonacci-matrix, and Lucas developments. The producing agent surveyed the current corpus and contribution-direction dossier and recommended a general Horadam companion-matrix theory as the best substantial project to develop while earlier upstream PRs wait. The human operator selected that recommendation and asked the agent to begin; the human did not author or materially edit the formal Lean statements or proofs. This submission connects LeanFrontier.Horadam.W to Mathlib's general LinearRecurrence abstraction and to the explicit 2x2 companion matrix [[P,-Q],[1,0]]. The public theorem surface proves that every Horadam sequence is a solution of the Mathlib recurrence, identifies the recurrence characteristic polynomial, proves one-step and arbitrary-power state-vector evolution, gives the explicit companion-matrix power formula in terms of the fundamental sequence W(P,Q,0,1), identifies determinant, trace, determinant powers, and the common characteristic polynomial X^2 - P X + Q, and derives the trace and characteristic polynomial of every positive companion-matrix power from the fundamental Horadam sequence and Q-powers. The supporting recurrence, companion-matrix, and explicit power-formula definitions are ordinary public mathematical API but are not claim entrypoints. The intended completed submission will add restrained Fibonacci/Lucas specializations and only further structural results that genuinely consume this core theory, keeping proof-only scaffolding private. No claim of new mathematics is made; this is a formalization and integration of classical second-order recurrence theory.
